visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair featuring red highlights, wearing a bright orange long-sleeved sweater and a gold ring on his ring finger, stands before a large window with greenery visible outside. He holds a vibrant orange smartphone and gestures toward several stacked cardboard boxes from 'RHINOSHIELD' and 'Lanyard' sitting on a light-colored wooden table. (2) A sharp close-up shows a product label on a cardboard box, detailing the 'CircularNext (Camera Button)' phone case with manufacturer information and barcodes. The background consists of a textured wooden surface. (3) The man holds a white plastic phone case featuring black and gold accents, with a distinctive aviation-themed graphic design on the back, including the words 'EXIT', 'DANGER', and 'STARLUX'. He rotates the case to show the inner MagSafe magnetic ring to the camera. (4) In a medium shot, the man snaps the orange smartphone into the white case, meticulously aligning the camera lenses with the cutout. He points out a small triangular graphic detail near the top right of the camera module. He then turns the phone over to reveal a lock screen featuring a photo of a woman holding a glass of wine. (5) A close-up view shows the man's hands opening a square cardboard box to reveal a circular black phone grip designed like an aircraft's attitude indicator instrument with yellow and green markings. (6) He attaches the grip to the back of the phone and extends the stand mechanism, showing how it props the phone up on the wooden table. (7) He presents a small, circular black adhesive chip with 'SUPER CARD' branding, identifying it as an integrated EasyCard component. (8) A detailed shot focuses on a black nylon lanyard strap with bright yellow stitching and 'STARLUX' and 'RHINOSHIELD' logo patches. The man stretches the fabric to demonstrate its texture and thickness. (9) The man wears the black lanyard around his neck with the phone attached, standing in a kitchen-like setting with gray cabinets. He holds the phone up to the camera while speaking. (10) The final scene shows the man sitting in the open trunk of a blue hatchback car parked on a mountain road, followed by an end-screen overlay with social media handles and QR codes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An adult male voice begins speaking in a cheerful, conversational tone with clear articulation. A light, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM establishes a rhythmic 4/4 background bed. (2) A soft percussive thud occurs as a box is placed on a table, followed by the sound of cardboard sliding. The speaker maintains high vocal arousal while describing the products. (3) A distinct plastic 'snap' sound is heard as the phone is encased. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (4) A series of short, digital-like 'pop' sound effects accentuate the unboxing of the phone grip. The male voice exhibits rising intonation when expressing excitement. (5) A dry rustling sound of paper and fabric occurs as the lanyard is handled. The acoustic guitar BGM continues with a bright, Major-mode melody. (6) The BGM volume swells slightly during the closing summary. A synthetic 'whoosh' transition effect marks the move to the final scene.
